commit.message:
fix(aro): bind readback verification to submitted receipt identity and bound all command latency

Immediate-consistency readback previously recomputed SHA-256 over the read-back canonical_payload and compared it to the read-back payload_hash_hex. Both values came from the same row, so the check proved only that the persisted row was internally self-consistent. A store returning a self-consistent but incorrect row passed verification.

Verification now also re-derives the idempotency key from the read-back ReceiptEnvelope (tenant:correlation:kind:payloadHash) and compares it to the requested key, binding row identity to row content. Failure is terminal and fail-closed via RECEIPT_HASH_MISMATCH.

Separately, connection acquisition was unbounded: OpenAsync() was called without a cancellation token in all six call sites and no CommandTimeout was set, so a stalled store could hang a governance decision indefinitely rather than failing closed. All six now pass ct, and commands are created through CreateTimedCommand with a 15s CommandTimeout.

feat(runtime): durable authority/accounting store with versioned v1-to-v2 migration (GMF-P2A)

- ReceiptPersistenceSchema: v2 authority/accounting schema (P1-C096 state families:
  spends P1-C108, unique effect attempts P1-C010/P1-C111, budget reservations
  P1-C073/P1-C115, concurrency slots P1-C109/P1-C120, pre-effect receipts P1-C109,
  pending-effect state, terminal receipts P1-C110 with P1-C103-P1-C105 closed sets,
  durable denials P1-C106/P1-C074/P1-C112, settlement P1-C116, quarantine P1-C113,
  governed actions); closed P1-C071 code vocabulary; D6 validation-binding columns;
  append-only triggers; per-class terminal-set trigger; versioned migration
  (PRAGMA user_version 1 -> 2, additive, v1 rows byte-for-byte preserved, partial
  states fail closed); explicit durable-state origin 'durable-store-v2'.
- SqlitePermissionSpendLedger: v1 seam unchanged in contract; migration delegated;
  typed SqliteAuthorityAccountingStore API + AuthorityStoreException boundary.
- SqliteControlledExecutionLedger: durable governed-action ledger (cutover target),
  append-only with P1-C112 conflicting-append detection.
- DI + LaunchExecution: cutover behind the receipt-persistence configuration switch
  with named semantics (pre-cutover in-memory records non-authoritative/not imported;
  consumption never resurrected; rollback leaves history intact and inert).
- LaunchReadiness: honest post-P2A readiness/blocker text (pinned prefixes preserved).
- IControlledExecutionLedger: doc-comment accuracy only; interface unchanged.

test(runtime): GMF-P2A store guarantees, migration/cutover, and effect-path negative control

- AuthorityAccountingStoreMigrationTests: v1 rows byte-for-byte preserved through
  v1 -> v2 (independent raw-SQL v1 fixture); fresh init reaches v2 (user_version,
  WAL, foreign keys, FK declarations); idempotent reopen; partially-migrated states
  cannot present as v2; cutover never imports/resurrects in-memory or consumed
  state; restart durability; rollback leaves v1 rows and v2 history intact/inert.
- AuthorityAccountingStoreTests: every AC(a) state family persists/reads back with
  P1-C109/P1-C110 bindings; duplicate attempts, double consumption, and conflicting
  terminals structurally rejected at the DB (raw SQL on separate connections) with
  the original standing and FLEET_DENIED_TERMINAL_CONFLICT evidence; concurrency
  race admits exactly the valid set with FLEET_DENIED_RACE_LOST losers (winner
  linkage, zero excess effect) and zero overspend; closed vocabularies enforced
  (P1-C071, P1-C103-P1-C105 per class); unknown-cost reservation stays reserved
  until append-only settlement; quarantine blocks reuse until reconciliation;
  UPDATE/DELETE rejected on all history tables.
- SqliteControlledExecutionLedgerTests: query parity, restart durability,
  append-only history, P1-C112 conflicting re-append detection, idempotent
  re-append, cutover origin semantics, and the receipt-persistence switch
  registration semantics.
- EffectPathDisabledTests: AC(d) negative control observed independently (static
  forbidden-API scan over the exact Allowed Files, host-level process census,
  sandbox filesystem census, raw-SQL database census); the handler's effect is
  exactly one governed-action row; the still-denied spend path reaches no effect.
- SqlitePermissionSpendLedgerTests: v2 reach through the seam; spend history
  append-only enforcement.

fix(runtime): per-event denial evidence ids and hardened terminal class-set trigger (GMF-P2A rework)

Review findings A-F1/B-F1 + A-F4 (both adversarial reviews converged):

- [A-F1/B-F1] Every derived DenialReceiptId is now unique per event (subject refs +
  event guid) on ALL auto-recorded evidence paths swept (reservation-quarantined,
  race-lost, terminal-conflict): a repeat denial/conflict/race/quarantine event can no
  longer PK-collide, so every documented false-returning method returns false on every
  repeat (never a store-failure exception) AND every event persists its own durable
  evidence row (P1-C112: repeat-conflict evidence is never silently dropped). The
  original terminal/winner always stands. Behavior contract documented on the methods.
- [A-F4] TerminalReceipts_class_set trigger hardened to the EXISTS form: a missing
  attempt row can never fall through vacuously — any insert not matching a REAL
  attempt's P1-C103-P1-C105 class set is rejected by the trigger itself. The migration
  converges the trigger to the hardened form idempotently (rows untouched), and schema
  verification fail-closes BEFORE any convergence DDL so partially-migrated states can
  never present as v2.

test(runtime): rework regression shapes, frozen vocabulary pins, trigger inventory, cutover factory (GMF-P2A rework)

Review findings A-F1..A-F4 + B-F1/B-F2:

- [A-F1/B-F1] Regression tests for every repeat shape, asserting BOTH the documented
  return value AND the persisted evidence rows: RepeatedConflictingTerminalAppends_
  ReturnFalse_PerEventConflictEvidencePersists (3 repeats, 3 evidence rows, original
  stands), ConcurrentConflictingTerminalAppends_ExactlyOneTerminal_NoExceptionEscape
  (one true, one false, one terminal, one conflict-evidence row), SecondRaceLossTo_
  DifferentWinner_ReturnsFalse_WinnerLinkedEvidenceForBothLosses, RetriedQuarantined_
  ReservationRecord_ReturnsFalse_EvidencePersistsPerEvent.
- [A-F3] Frozen vocabularies pinned as test-side literals (all 26 P1-C071 code names,
  complete P1-C103-P1-C105 terminal-state sets, P1-C001 classes):
  FrozenVocabularies_ArePinnedAsLiterals_ProductionConstantsMustNotDrift — production
  drift breaks the suite; the code-admission loop now iterates the frozen literals.
- [A-F4] TerminalClassSetTrigger_RejectsDanglingAttempt_IndependentOfForeignKeys —
  proves the TRIGGER (not the FK) rejects a dangling-attempt terminal (probe connection
  runs with foreign keys OFF). TriggerInventory_IsExactlyTheRequired21_ByName asserts
  the trigger inventory by count AND exact names (10 append-only pairs +
  TerminalReceipts_class_set).
- [A-F2/B-F2] LaunchExecutionCutoverTests (ratified 13th Allowed File): the
  AddLaunchExecution factory runs through the receipt-persistence switch — durable
  SqliteControlledExecutionLedger with the configured connection string honored when
  Enabled, InMemoryControlledExecutionLedger otherwise (no database file), in both
  registration orders; handler wiring covered. EffectPathDisabledTests scans all 13
  Allowed Files and scopes its wired-surface claim honestly to what this assembly can
  reach, naming LaunchExecutionCutoverTests as the factory's covering test.

commit.message:
fix(control): route API-key randomness through the ISecureRandom seam (KEON003)

The recovery merge of PR #192 brought back ControlPlaneStore.RandomToken calling
RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes directly, which ForbiddenApiAnalyzer (KEON003)
bans in Keon.Control - the analyzer's own guidance names the missing abstraction
('Use ISecureRandom abstraction'), which nothing in the tree implemented.

This adds that seam (Keon.Contracts.Security.ISecureRandom + SecureRandom over
the platform CSPRNG, in the non-enforced contracts assembly so minting has
exactly one audited point) and has ControlPlaneStore consume it. API-key
prefix/secret/salt entropy is unchanged - still cryptographically random.

dotnet build Keon.sln: 0 errors (KEON003 resolved).
Keon.Control.Tests 53/53, Keon.Analyzers.Tests 60/60.

fix(runtime): enforce the pre-alpha MRF shape gates the memory governance tests specify

The recovery batch merged MemoryGovernanceTests (expecting fail-closed gating)
alongside an older MemoryRoutingFirewall whose VerifySignature/VerifyLineage
were '=> true' stubs - MRF_InvalidSignature_FailsClosedBeforeAlpha failed on
main with a NullReferenceException because a legacy placeholder signature passed
the stub and a mock alpha returned null.

Per the tests' encoded contract (ValidSignature = non-empty base64,
ValidLineageHash = 'sha256:<64-hex>', placeholder 'valid' must fail closed
BEFORE alpha):
- VerifySignature: reject empty/non-base64 signatures (legacy placeholders fail closed).
- VerifyLineage: require the sha256:<64-hex> shape.
- A null alpha decision now denies FailClosed instead of throwing.

dotnet build Keon.sln: 0 errors. Keon.Core.Tests 16/16 (previously 15/16),
Keon.Runtime.Tests 250/250.

+# Parcel: KEO-193-P1-RUNTIME-HTTP-CONTRACT
+
+## Goal
+
+Implement the versioned Runtime producer HTTP contract over the merged v2 receipt
+schema: authenticated authorization/completion issuance, bound retrieval, deterministic
+errors, durable signed storage, fail-closed composition, and hostile local verification.
+
+## Initiative
+
+KEO-193
+
+## Project Track
+
+keon-systems / Keon.Runtime.Api producer HTTP boundary
+
+## Wave
+
+Integration / Hardening
+
+## Branch
+
+codex/keo-193-runtime-http-contract
+
+## Worktree
+
+D:/Repos/keon-omega/_worktrees/keo-193-runtime-http-contract
+
+## Dependencies
+
+- PR #172 merged at 50895fa249e885bcdea127b2b9651d2b07555cbc
+
+## Integration Surfaces
+
+- KEO-193-producer-http-v2: authenticated producer -> Runtime receipt issuance/retrieval
+- KEO-193-runtime-to-biostack-v2: Runtime producer v2 receipt contract -> serialized consumer contract
+
+## Security Gate
+
+security review required before release; local security review evidence required before
+this parcel is considered green.
+
+## Allowed Files
+
+- docs/PARCELS/KEO-193-P1-RUNTIME-HTTP-CONTRACT.md
+- src/Keon.Runtime.Api/Program.cs
+- src/Keon.Runtime.Api/ProducerHttpContract.cs
+- src/Keon.Runtime.Api/ProducerHttpComposition.cs
+- src/Keon.Runtime.Api/ProducerHttpEndpoints.cs
+- src/Keon.Runtime.Api/README.md
+- tests/Keon.Runtime.Api.Tests/ProducerRuntimeHttpContractTests.cs
+- keon-contracts/contracts/openapi/keon.runtime.producer.v2.yaml
+- keon-contracts/contracts/producer/README.md
+- keon-contracts/contracts/vectors/producer/v2/http_valid_requests.json
+- keon-contracts/contracts/vectors/producer/v2/http_expected_errors.json
+- docs/security/KEO-193-P1-RUNTIME-HTTP-SECURITY-REVIEW.md
+
+No file outside this list may be created or changed. The merged
+`keon.runtime.producer.v2.schema.json` and its existing v2 receipt vectors are stable
+and are not editable in this parcel.
+
+## Forbidden
+
+- Do not edit or weaken `LaunchReadiness`, `launchGrade`, harness isolation, or existing
+  `/runtime/v1` behavior.
+- Do not pass inbound `Authorization` or bearer material to the receipt store or any
+  downstream service; only the mapped opaque `ProducerAuthBinding` may cross the boundary.
+- Do not add live IdP calls, deployment, merge, push, PR creation, credential reads, or
+  production enablement.
+- Do not use real identities, secrets, or keys in tests; all credentials and Ed25519
+  material are synthetic.
+- Do not return raw SQLite, configuration, exception, token, or secret content in HTTP
+  errors or logs.
+- Do not silently change the v2 receipt schema, receipt taxonomy, or existing vectors.
+- Do not make BioStack changes; its consumer remains serialized behind this parcel.
+
+## Out of Scope
+
+- External OIDC/JWT authority selection, JWKS discovery, mTLS, or production secret
+  provisioning. The host supplies a config-backed opaque service-credential map for this
+  parcel; missing configuration is unavailable/fail-closed.
+- Any change to existing v1 decide/execute endpoints.
+- Live Keon enablement, staging/production validation, deployment manifests, or costful
+  infrastructure actions.
+- Execution side effects. This parcel issues/retrieves producer receipts only.
+
+## Explicit Contract Decisions
+
+- HTTP version: `v2`; routes are `/runtime/v2/producer/authorization`,
+  `/runtime/v2/producer/completion`, and
+  `/runtime/v2/producer/receipts/{receiptId}`.
+- Authentication transport: `Authorization: Bearer <opaque service credential>` is
+  checked against the host's configured credential map. The secret is never persisted,
+  logged, or forwarded. The configured record supplies tenant, actor, subject, audience,
+  credential type, and credential id.
+- The configured credential audience is the authority-bound audience for the mapped
+  identity. The route never accepts tenant, actor, or audience from the JSON body.
+- Missing credential-map, signer, signing-key, or durable-store configuration returns a
+  deterministic unavailable response; it must never fall back to allow-all or in-memory
+  producer receipts.
+- The stable v2 receipt schema is unchanged. Existing store semantics, including the
+  v2 completion request-fingerprint binding, remain authoritative.
+
+## Contract
+
+### Authorization issuance
+
+`POST /runtime/v2/producer/authorization`
+
+Request body: `operationId`, `idempotencyKey`, `requestFingerprint`, and `status`
+(`authorized` or `denied`). The authenticated service identity supplies `auth`,
+`tenantId`, and `actorId`; `authorizationReceiptId` and result fields are not accepted.
+
+### Completion issuance
+
+`POST /runtime/v2/producer/completion`
+
+Request body: `operationId`, `idempotencyKey`, `requestFingerprint`,
+`authorizationReceiptId`, `status` (`completed` or `failed`), `resultFingerprint`, and
+optional `completedAtUtc`. The store requires the referenced authorization to be signed,
+authorized, and bound to the same operation, request fingerprint, tenant, actor, and
+configured audience.
+
+### Retrieval
+
+`GET /runtime/v2/producer/receipts/{receiptId}`
+
+The authenticated identity supplies the tenant, actor, and audience lookup binding. A
+successful response contains the signed v2 receipt. Wrong tenant, actor, audience, or
+signature is denied with the stable machine-readable error code.
+
+### Error mapping
+
+All producer routes return `{ success, data, error }`.
+
+| HTTP | Codes |
+|---:|---|
+| 400 | request/receipt validation codes |
+| 401 | `PRODUCER_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED`, `PRODUCER_AUTHENTICATION_INVALID` |
+| 403 | `TENANT_MISMATCH`, `ACTOR_MISMATCH`, `AUDIENCE_MISMATCH`, `SIGNATURE_INVALID` |
+| 404 | `RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND` |
+| 409 | `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`, `AUTHORIZATION_NOT_FOUND`, `AUTHORIZATION_CONTEXT_MISMATCH` |
+| 503 | `PRODUCER_AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED`, `PRODUCER_RECEIPT_STORE_UNAVAILABLE` |
+
+An identical idempotent request returns the original signed receipt. A changed request
+under the same tenant/phase/idempotency key returns `409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`.
+
+## Required Tests
+
+- Unauthenticated and invalid-credential requests are rejected without issuance.
+- Authorization and completion issue/replay return the same durable signed receipt.
+- Wrong tenant, actor, and audience retrievals are denied.
+- Invalid/mismatched authorization and operation binding are rejected.
+- Idempotency replay conflicts are deterministic.
+- Signature tamper is rejected.
+- Missing/broken durable store configuration is unavailable and fail-closed.
+- Existing launch/harness and v1 endpoint tests remain green.
+- OpenAPI and JSON fixture files parse and align with the stable v2 schema.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- Only the allowed files change.
+- All three v2 producer routes require the mapped service identity.
+- The backend receives only `ProducerAuthBinding`, never inbound bearer material.
+- Receipts are persisted by `SqliteProducerReceiptStore` and signed with synthetic Ed25519
+  test keys.
+- Launch mode remains fail-closed and reports `launchGrade: false` in harness mode.
+- Focused API/producer tests, relevant contract tests, and the full relevant .NET test
+  suite pass, or exact blockers are recorded.
+- The security review has no unresolved High/Critical finding.
+
+## Verification
+
+- `rtk dotnet test tests/Keon.Runtime.Api.Tests/Keon.Runtime.Api.Tests.csproj -c Release --no-restore`
+- `rtk dotnet test tests/Keon.Runtime.Tests/Keon.Runtime.Tests.csproj -c Release --no-restore`
+- `rtk dotnet test tests/Keon.Determinism.Tests/Keon.Determinism.Tests.csproj -c Release --no-restore`
+- `rtk dotnet test Keon.sln -c Release --no-restore`
+- `rtk proxy python -c "import json; ..."` for the v2 HTTP fixtures and schema shape
+- static security review of auth, route, config, durable-store, and error paths
+
+## Evidence Required
+
+- Focused and full test command output with exact commit.
+- OpenAPI/fixture parse result.
+- `docs/security/KEO-193-P1-RUNTIME-HTTP-SECURITY-REVIEW.md`.
+- This file's completed Session Handoff.
+
+## Collision Risk
+
+High. `Program.cs`, the API route surface, and the OpenAPI contract are serialization
+points. No parallel parcel may edit them until this parcel is complete.
+
+## PR Notes
+
+- What changed: versioned producer HTTP issuance/retrieval contract and fail-closed host wiring.
+- Why: unblock serialized consumers behind KEO-193 without reviving the legacy receipt surface.
+- Risk: static credential-map authentication is deliberately not a substitute for a selected
+  external authority; launch remains blocked.
+- Verification: focused hostile HTTP tests plus existing v1, receipt, determinism, and full tests.
+- Evidence: test output, OpenAPI/fixture parse, and security review artifact.
+
+## BioStack Consumer Unblockers
+
+### 1. Exact artifact identity
+
+- **Implementation commit:** `7eeb674` (`KEO-193 add runtime producer HTTP v2 contract`)
+- **Branch:** `codex/keo-193-runtime-http-contract`
+- **Worktree:** `D:/Repos/keon-omega/_worktrees/keo-193-runtime-http-contract`
+- **Files:**
+  - `src/Keon.Runtime.Api/Program.cs`
+  - `src/Keon.Runtime.Api/ProducerHttpContract.cs`
+  - `src/Keon.Runtime.Api/ProducerHttpComposition.cs`
+  - `src/Keon.Runtime.Api/ProducerHttpEndpoints.cs`
+  - `tests/Keon.Runtime.Api.Tests/ProducerRuntimeHttpContractTests.cs`
+  - `src/Keon.Runtime.Api/README.md`
+  - `keon-contracts/contracts/openapi/keon.runtime.producer.v2.yaml`
+  - `keon-contracts/contracts/producer/README.md`
+  - `keon-contracts/contracts/vectors/producer/v2/http_valid_requests.json`
+  - `keon-contracts/contracts/vectors/producer/v2/http_expected_errors.json`
+  - `docs/PARCELS/KEO-193-P1-RUNTIME-HTTP-CONTRACT.md`
+  - `docs/security/KEO-193-P1-RUNTIME-HTTP-SECURITY-REVIEW.md`
+- The stable `keon.runtime.producer.v2.schema.json` and existing v2 receipt vectors are
+  unchanged.
+
+### 2. Endpoints, methods, envelopes, statuses, and errors
+
+All routes use JSON envelope `{ "success": true, "data": <ProducerReceipt>, "error": null }`
+on success and `{ "success": false, "data": null, "error": { "code", "message" } }`
+on failure. Successful issuance/replay and retrieval return `200`.
+
+| Method and route | Purpose | Error status/code families |
+|---|---|---|
+| `POST /runtime/v2/producer/authorization` | Issue/replay authorization receipt | `400 AUTHORIZATION_REQUEST_INVALID` or v2 validation code; `401 PRODUCER_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED` / `PRODUCER_AUTHENTICATION_INVALID`; `409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; `503 PRODUCER_AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED` / `PRODUCER_RECEIPT_STORE_UNAVAILABLE` |
+| `POST /runtime/v2/producer/completion` | Issue/replay completion receipt | `400 COMPLETION_REQUEST_INVALID` or v2 validation code; `401` auth codes; `409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`, `AUTHORIZATION_NOT_FOUND`, `AUTHORIZATION_CONTEXT_MISMATCH`; `503 PRODUCER_RECEIPT_STORE_UNAVAILABLE` |
+| `GET /runtime/v2/producer/receipts/{receiptId}` | Retrieve by authenticated binding | `401` auth codes; `403 TENANT_MISMATCH`, `ACTOR_MISMATCH`, `AUDIENCE_MISMATCH`, `SIGNATURE_INVALID`; `404 RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND`; `503 PRODUCER_RECEIPT_STORE_UNAVAILABLE` |
+
+The producer status values are `authorized`/`denied` for authorization and
+`completed`/`failed` for completion. The HTTP wire representation is lowercase and
+matches the stable v2 schema.
+
+### 3. Subject, audience, credential, and header-token mapping
+
+- Inbound header: `Authorization: Bearer <opaque-service-credential>`.
+- The bearer value is looked up against `KEON_RUNTIME_PRODUCER_CREDENTIALS`; it is not
+  accepted in JSON, persisted, logged by this boundary, returned, or forwarded downstream.
+- A configured credential record maps:
+  - `credentialId` -> `ProducerAuthBinding.CredentialId`
+  - `credentialType` -> `ProducerAuthBinding.CredentialType`
+  - `subject` -> `ProducerAuthBinding.Subject`
+  - `audience` -> `ProducerAuthBinding.Audience`
+  - `tenantId` -> `ProducerAuthBinding.TenantId`
+  - `actorId` -> `ProducerAuthBinding.ActorId`
+- The mapped `tenantId`, `actorId`, and `audience` are the only retrieval lookup identity;
+  caller JSON cannot override them. The implementation's synthetic test mapping uses
+  `biostack-service`, `keon-runtime`, `service-delegation`, and fixture tenant/actor ids;
+  these are not production credentials or authority claims.
+
+### 4. Authorization, completion, denied, and failed phase rules
+
+- Authorization issues a signed v2 receipt with phase `authorization` and status
+  `authorized` or `denied`; it has no parent receipt and no result fingerprint.
+- Completion requires `authorizationReceiptId`, result fingerprint, and phase/status
+  `completion`/`completed` or `completion`/`failed`.
+- The referenced authorization must be found, signature-valid, `authorized`, and bound to
+  the same tenant, actor, subject, audience, operation, and request fingerprint.
+- A denied authorization can never produce a completion receipt.
+- A completed completion requires `completedAtUtc`; a failed completion must not carry it.
+- Every completion status requires a result fingerprint. No denied or failed receipt may
+  be treated as a successful execution authorization.
+
+### 5. operationId, idempotency, retry, and reconciliation derivation
+
+- `operationId` is the durable logical operation key. Completion links to authorization
+  by `authorizationReceiptId` and must retain the same operation and binding.
+- `idempotencyKey` is scoped to `tenantId + phase`. Exact replay of the same phase,
+  operation, fingerprint, parent, result, and binding returns the original signed receipt.
+- Reusing a key with any changed fingerprint, operation, parent, result, or binding returns
+  `409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`; do not mint a new receipt or blindly retry with a new key.
+- Safe client retry: retry a timeout or `503` with the same phase/idempotency key after
+  store recovery, then reconcile by receipt id and operation id. Do not retry `400`, `401`,
+  `403`, `404`, or `409` without correcting the input or identity.
+- Reconciliation fields are `receiptId`, `phase`, `status`, `operationId`,
+  `authorizationReceiptId`, `tenantId`, `actorId`, `auth.audience`,
+  `requestFingerprint`, `resultFingerprint`, `issuedAtUtc`, `completedAtUtc`, and the
+  Ed25519 signature metadata. Consumers must verify the signature before promotion.
+
+### 6. BioStack DecisionReceipt/Spine compatibility guidance
+
+- Treat a verified producer authorization receipt as an external, versioned decision
+  artifact: `authorized` maps to an allow/approved compatibility result and `denied` maps
+  to a deny/refusal result. Preserve the producer `receiptId`, `operationId`, tenant/actor,
+  audience, request fingerprint, and signature metadata; do not create legacy
+  `keon://receipt/stub-*` values.
+- Do not deserialize a producer receipt as a native Keon `DecisionReceipt` unless the
+  adapter explicitly preserves the v2 version/signature and marks the source as producer
+  v2. A compatibility wrapper may expose the verified producer receipt as the decision
+  reference, but it must not claim local Keon authority or execution.
+- For Spine, append an authorization event containing operation, producer receipt id,
+  phase/status, identity binding, request fingerprint, and signature verification result.
+  Append completion only when `authorizationReceiptId` links to the verified authorized
+  event and operation/binding match. A denied authorization appends refusal/denial
+  evidence only; a failed completion appends terminal failure evidence, never success.
+- Keep `authorizationReceiptId` as the lineage edge from completion to authorization;
+  keep `resultFingerprint` as completion evidence. No consumer may promote, execute,
+  acquire live data, or infer success from an unverified or fixture-only receipt.

+# Determinism Seal Contract
+
+## Purpose
+
+This document defines the authoritative determinism seal contract for governance-visible run sealing.
+It is designed to be fail-closed and reviewable.
+
+## Canonical Seal Manifest (Authoritative Schema)
+
+The determinism seal manifest MUST canonicalize as JSON (JCS / RFC 8785-compatible behavior via `KeonCanonicalJsonV1`) before hashing and signing.
+
+```json
+{
+  "manifestVersion": "1.0",
+  "runId": "uuidv7",
+  "tenantId": "string",
+  "correlationId": "string",
+  "policyHash": "sha256",
+  "payloadHash": "sha256",
+  "timestamp": "ISO-8601",
+  "signature": "detached-ed25519"
+}
+```
+
+## Seal Chain (Fail-Closed)
+
+1. Canonicalize manifest JSON using JCS-compatible canonicalization (`src/Keon.Canonicalization/KeonCanonicalJsonV1.cs`).
+2. Compute deterministic SHA-256 over canonical bytes.
+3. Sign canonical bytes with Ed25519 (detached signature).
+4. Validate in CI and verification paths; any mismatch fails the job/process.
+
+## Failure Modes (Required Behavior)
+
+| Failure | Behavior |
+| --- | --- |
+| Canonicalization mismatch | Fail seal generation |
+| Hash mismatch | Fail seal validation |
+| Signature invalid | CI hard fail |
+| Missing manifest | CI hard fail |
+
+No warnings-only mode is permitted for seal validation.
+
+## Current Enforcement Mapping (Repo)
+
+- Canonicalization source of truth: `src/Keon.Canonicalization/KeonCanonicalJsonV1.cs`
+- SHA-256 hashing in verifier paths: `src/Keon.Verify/PackVerifier.cs`, `src/Keon.Verify/Hashing.cs`
+- Ed25519 verification: `src/Keon.Verify/Ed25519.cs`
+- CI determinism hard-fail gates:
+  - `.github/workflows/determinism-gate.yml`
+  - `.github/workflows/determinism-seal.yml`
+- Negative-path tests (missing manifest / hash mismatch / signature invalid):
+  - `tests/Keon.Verify.Tests/PackVerifierTests.cs`
+
+## Notes
+
+The existing evidence-pack `manifest.json` (`version = "v1"`) and attestation objects remain the current pack-verification contract.
+The schema above is the governance-facing determinism seal contract and should be adopted as the single visible seal payload for runtime/control-plane integration.

+# Spine Invariants (v1)
+
+## Definition (v1)
+
+Spine is the canonical, append-only, partitioned, causally ordered memory backbone of Keon.
+
+**It provides:**
+
+- UUIDv7 identity (monotonic, time-ordered)
+- Causality propagation across boundaries
+- Correlation continuity
+- Deterministic, partition-scoped ordering
+- Immutable append-only persistence semantics
+
+Spine is the only source of truth for runtime causal history.
+
+## Invariants (Mandatory, v1)
+
+1. All runtime events use UUIDv7.
+2. All cross-component calls propagate `CausalityContext`.
+3. No ad-hoc GUID generation outside Spine.
+4. Contracts must be Spine-aware.
+5. Tests validate correlation continuity.
+6. Spine persistence is append-only. No mutation or overwrite.
+7. Spine ordering is partition-scoped. No global ordering assumption.
+
+## Adoption Order (Strict)
+
+1. Contracts
+2. Runtime
+3. Determinism layer
+4. SDK
+5. Control UI bindings
+
+## Adoption Rules
+
+- No piecemeal migration by feature slice.
+- No temporary GUID generation in migrated paths.
+- Any exception must be documented with:
+  - scope
+  - reason
+  - expiry/removal condition
+  - owner
+
+## Verification Expectations
+
+- Runtime tests assert UUIDv7 generation and propagation.
+- Contract tests reject missing/non-Spine correlation fields in Spine-enabled APIs.
+- Determinism tests include correlation continuity in signed/canonical payloads.
+- Control UI bindings treat missing Spine identifiers as governance-invalid data and fail closed in presentation.
+
+Use this as a paste-ready doc snippet (fits `docs/golden-thread/SPINE_INVARIANTS.md` or a new `docs/golden-thread/MEMORY_V1_MODEL.md`).
+
+## Memory Model (v1) — Spine-First
+
+Legend:
+- `✅` Implemented / canonical in v1
+- `🟡` Spec-defined, deferred in implementation
+- `⚪` Planned / not yet implemented
+
+### Status
+- `✅` Canonical persisted memory atom: `SpineEvent`
+- `🟡` `IMemory` (spec-level abstraction only; no runtime interface in v1)
+- `⚪` Typed memory records: `Trigger`, `Intent`, `Decision`, `Action`, `Outcome` (planned)
+
+### v1 Contract (Normative)
+1. **`SpineEvent` is the only canonical persisted memory atom in v1.**
+2. v1 implementations **must not** introduce an ad-hoc runtime `IMemory` interface as a persistence contract.
+3. Typed memory objects (`Trigger` / `Intent` / `Decision` / `Action` / `Outcome`) are **deferred** until real producers exist beyond trace-derived events.
+4. Typed memory objects may be introduced first as **projections** over `SpineEvent`.
+5. Promotion of typed memory objects to first-class persisted records requires:
+   - multi-producer evidence (not trace-only)
+   - explicit schema/versioning
+   - causality lineage preservation back to originating `SpineEvent`
+6. SpineEvent must remain schema-stable once introduced; additive-only changes permitted, breaking changes require versioned envelope.
+
+### Causality / Lineage Invariant
+- Every projected or promoted memory record must preserve traceability to source `SpineEvent` records, including:
+  - `runId`
+  - correlation/causality identifiers
+  - timestamps/order semantics
+  - provenance sufficient for audit reconstruction
+  - policy/evaluation binding identifiers (when governance is involved)
+
+### Non-Goals (v1)
+- No universal `IMemory` runtime abstraction
+- No premature typed-memory persistence schema
+- No producer-specific memory formats treated as canonical
+
+### Rationale
+v1 optimizes for determinism, auditability, and causal integrity. `SpineEvent` provides a stable, governance-compatible substrate while upstream producers are still maturing.
+

+# Security Review — KEO-193-P1 Runtime Producer HTTP Contract
+
+**Date:** 2026-07-28
+**Reviewer:** security-review skill
+**Depth:** Standard
+**Mode:** Local / passive source review plus synthetic in-process hostile tests
+
+## Executive summary
+
+The producer v2 HTTP boundary is fail-closed when identity, signing, or durable-store
+configuration is absent. The routes derive tenant, actor, subject, audience, credential
+type, and credential id from a configured service-credential mapping; request JSON cannot
+override those fields. Only the derived `ProducerAuthBinding` reaches the durable receipt
+store. The bearer value is not included in the v2 receipt, response, or store API.
+
+The local hostile suite covers unauthenticated access, tenant/actor/audience confusion,
+authorization and operation mismatch, idempotency conflict, signature-invalid retrieval,
+durable-store unavailability, signed replay, and durable retrieval. No Critical or High
+finding remains in this parcel. Launch mode and launch-grade claims remain blocked by the
+pre-existing `LaunchReadiness` gate.
+
+## Findings summary
+
+| ID | Severity | Title | Locator | Framework |
+|---|---|---|---|---|
+| F-001 | Medium | Config-backed credential transport is not an external authority | `src/Keon.Runtime.Api/ProducerHttpComposition.cs` | OWASP API2 / CWE-287 |
+| F-002 | Low | No producer-specific rate limit is implemented | `src/Keon.Runtime.Api/ProducerHttpEndpoints.cs` | OWASP API4 |
+| F-003 | Informational | Launch remains fail-closed until the broader authority decision is delivered | `src/Keon.Runtime.Api/LaunchReadiness.cs` | CWE-636 |
+
+## Detailed findings
+
+### F-001: Config-backed credential transport is not an external authority
+
+- **Severity:** Medium
+- **Confidence:** High
+- **Locator:** `src/Keon.Runtime.Api/ProducerHttpComposition.cs` credential parsing and `src/Keon.Runtime.Api/ProducerHttpContract.cs` bearer mapping
+- **Description:** This parcel authenticates an opaque bearer credential by constant-time comparison against a host-configured map. It does not validate an external JWT issuer, JWKS, mTLS identity, expiry, revocation, or network-bound audience.
+- **Evidence:** Missing or malformed credential configuration returns `503 PRODUCER_AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED`; unknown credentials return `401 PRODUCER_AUTHENTICATION_INVALID`; duplicate credential ids/secrets invalidate the map rather than selecting ambiguously. The mapped audience is persisted, while the secret is not.
+- **Impact:** If this transport were promoted as production authority without a separately approved identity provider and credential lifecycle, compromise of the configured service secret would grant the mapped tenant/actor scope until rotation.
+- **Remediation:** Keep launch disabled. Before production enablement, ratify the external authority, issuer/audience, key-discovery, expiry, revocation, and rotation contract; replace or wrap this mapper with verified claims/mTLS while preserving the no-token-passthrough boundary.
+- **Framework mapping:** OWASP API2, CWE-287
+
+### F-002: No producer-specific rate limit is implemented
+
+- **Severity:** Low
+- **Confidence:** High
+- **Locator:** `src/Keon.Runtime.Api/ProducerHttpEndpoints.cs` producer route group
+- **Description:** The parcel does not add issuance/retrieval rate limiting or abuse controls.
+- **Evidence:** The route group has deterministic auth, binding, idempotency, and durable-store checks but no limiter registration.
+- **Impact:** An authenticated caller could consume database and signing capacity until an upstream limiter exists.
+- **Remediation:** Add a separately scoped rate-limit parcel after the authority and deployment contract is ratified; key limits by authenticated credential/tenant and fail closed on limiter unavailability if required by the launch gate.
+- **Framework mapping:** OWASP API4
+
+### F-003: Launch remains fail-closed until the broader authority decision is delivered
+
+- **Severity:** Informational
+- **Confidence:** High
+- **Locator:** `src/Keon.Runtime.Api/LaunchReadiness.cs`
+- **Description:** `KEON_RUNTIME_MODE=launch` still throws before serving because the broader runtime launch blockers remain. Producer v2 configuration does not bypass that gate.
+- **Evidence:** Existing launch-readiness tests remain part of the 40-test API suite and no launch-readiness file was changed.
+- **Impact:** No partial producer implementation can be mistaken for launch-grade Keon authority.
+- **Remediation:** None in this parcel. Track external authority, production signing/key lifecycle, execution durability, and chain continuity as separate release gates.
+- **Framework mapping:** CWE-636
+
+## Threat model coverage
+
+| Boundary | Control verified |
+|---|---|
+| Public HTTP -> identity | Missing, malformed, unknown, and duplicate credentials fail closed. |
+| Identity -> receipt store | Only `ProducerAuthBinding` crosses the boundary; no bearer field exists in the backend request. |
+| Request -> authorization | Tenant/actor/audience are not accepted in JSON; status and v2 receipt validation are deterministic. |
+| Completion -> authorization | Signed authorization, same operation, identity, and request fingerprint are required by the stable store. |
+| Retrieval -> tenant isolation | Store lookup checks tenant, actor, audience, then signature. |
+| Retry/replay -> durable state | SQLite uniqueness and conflict mapping preserve idempotency. |
+| Store/signature failure -> HTTP | Store failures return `503`; tampered signatures return `403 SIGNATURE_INVALID`. |
+| Harness/launch boundary | Existing harness remains `launchGrade: false`; launch remains fail-fast. |
+
+## Test evidence
+
+- `tests/Keon.Runtime.Api.Tests`: 40 passed, including 6 producer hostile tests.
+- `tests/Keon.Runtime.Tests`: 202 passed, including durable v2 receipt and signature tests.
+- `tests/Keon.Determinism.Tests`: 42 passed.
+- OpenAPI/fixture parse: passed; 3 routes, 2 HTTP fixture files, stable schema version `keon.runtime.producer.v2`.
+
+## Coverage gaps
+
+- No live service, deployment, external identity provider, JWKS, mTLS, credential rotation,
+  rate-limit, staging, or production review was performed.
+- No real credentials, customer data, or production keys were used.
+- The config-backed transport is a bounded local contract implementation, not evidence of
+  launch-grade authority.
+
+## Gate result
+
+No unresolved Critical or High finding. Security evidence is complete for this local
+parcel, but the overall KEO-193/Keon launch gate remains **HOLD / NO-GO** until the
+external authority and production launch blockers are separately ratified and verified.

+public static class TenantControlHttp
+{
+    public static TenantRequestContext ResolveTenantContext(HttpContext httpContext, ControlPlaneStore store)
+    {
+        var requestedTenantId =
+            httpContext.User.FindFirstValue("tenant_id")
+            ?? httpContext.User.FindFirstValue("tenantId")
+            ?? httpContext.Request.Headers["X-Tenant-Id"].FirstOrDefault();
+
+        var tenant = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestedTenantId)
+            ? store.GetTenant(requestedTenantId)
+            : store.GetTenants().FirstOrDefault();
+
+        if (tenant is null)
+        {
+            throw new InvalidOperationException("No tenant is available for the current request.");
+        }
+
+        var roles = httpContext.User.FindAll("role")
+            .Select(c => c.Value)
+            .Concat(httpContext.User.FindAll(ClaimTypes.Role).Select(c => c.Value))
+            .Concat(ParseRolesHeader(httpContext.Request.Headers["X-Roles"].FirstOrDefault()))
+            .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
+            .ToArray();
+
+        if (roles.Length == 0)
+        {
+            roles = ["tenant_admin"];
+        }
+
+        return new TenantRequestContext(
+            TenantId: tenant.Id,
+            TenantName: tenant.Name,
+            PlanId: NormalizePlanId(tenant.CurrentPlanCode),
+            Roles: roles);
+    }
+
+    public static ApiEnvelope<T> Success<T>(HttpContext httpContext, TenantRequestContext tenant, T data, string? cursor = null)
+        => new(
+            Ok: true,
+            Data: data,
+            Error: null,
+            Meta: new ApiMeta(
+                RequestId: httpContext.TraceIdentifier,
+                TenantId: tenant.TenantId,
+                PlanId: tenant.PlanId,
+                Cursor: cursor));
+
+    public static ApiEnvelope<object> Failure(HttpContext httpContext, TenantRequestContext tenant, string code, string message, object? details = null)
+        => new(
+            Ok: false,
+            Data: null,
+            Error: new ApiErrorBody(code, message, details),
+            Meta: new ApiMeta(
+                RequestId: httpContext.TraceIdentifier,
+                TenantId: tenant.TenantId,
+                PlanId: tenant.PlanId));
+
+    public static string NormalizePlanId(string? planId)
+        => string.Equals(planId, "builder", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "free" : (planId ?? "free").ToLowerInvariant();
+
+    public static TenantLimitsResponse BuildLimits(PlanRecord plan)
+        => new(
+            ExecutionsPerMonth: plan.IncludedExecutions,
+            ApiKeys: plan.ApiKeysMax,
+            Projects: plan.ProjectsMax,
+            EvidenceExport: plan.EvidenceExportEnabled,
+            PolicyEditing: plan.PolicyConfigurationEnabled,
+            Webhooks: plan.PolicyConfigurationEnabled,
+            OrgTenants: string.Equals(NormalizePlanId(plan.Code), "enterprise", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase),
+            Sso: plan.SsoEnabled,
+            DedicatedRuntime: plan.DedicatedRuntimeEnabled);
+
+    private static IEnumerable<string> ParseRolesHeader(string? raw)
+    {
+        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(raw))
+        {
+            return [];
+        }
+
+        return raw
+            .Split(',', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries | StringSplitOptions.TrimEntries)
+            .Where(role => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(role));
+    }

+                            ("@slot_scope", request.SlotScope!), ("@slot_index", request.SlotIndex!.Value));

+                            Rollback(connection);

+                                LinkedReceiptId: null,
+                                DeniedAtUtc: request.AttemptedAtUtc));

+                    var spendIndex = currentCount + 1;

+
+                    evaluation?.OnStep(SpendBoundaryStep.ConsumePermission);
+                    Execute(connection, @"

+                        ("@permission_id", request.PermissionId),

+                    evaluation?.OnStep(SpendBoundaryStep.AcquireSlot);
+                    if (request.SlotId is not null)

+                        Execute(connection, @"

+    /// <summary>
+    /// Appends the one terminal receipt for an effect (P1-C102/P1-C110). A conflicting or
+    /// duplicate terminal append is rejected with the original terminal standing and a
+    /// per-event FLEET_DENIED_TERMINAL_CONFLICT denial receipt in <paramref name="denialReceiptId"/>
+    /// (P1-C112); repeats return false and persist their own evidence rows — never throw.
+    /// The terminal state must belong to the closed set of the effect's class (P1-C103–P1-C105),
+    /// and the cost state is a settled amount or the explicit FLEET_PENDING_UNKNOWN_COST marker
+    /// (P1-C115).
+    /// </summary>
+    public bool TryAppendTerminal(TerminalReceiptInput input, out string? denialReceiptId)
+    {
+        ValidateTerminalInput(input);
+        denialReceiptId = null;
+
+        for (var attempt = 0; ; attempt++)
+        {
+            try
+            {
+                using var connection = OpenChecked();
+
+                using (var begin = connection.CreateCommand())
+                {
+                    begin.CommandText = "BEGIN IMMEDIATE;";
+                    begin.ExecuteNonQuery();
+                }
+
+                try
+                {
+                    var effectClass = ScalarString(connection,
+                        "SELECT EffectClass FROM EffectAttempts WHERE EffectId = @effect_id;",
+                        ("@effect_id", input.EffectId));
+
+                    if (effectClass is null)
+                    {
+                        // No attempt row: invalid request (validation of existence is P2B's),
+                        // rejected structurally here and by trg_terminal_receipts_class_set even
+                        // with foreign keys off. No denial evidence: nothing was denied, and the
+                        // caller has no effect to hang evidence on.
+                        Rollback(connection);
+                        return false;
+                    }
+
+                    if (!ReceiptPersistenceSchema.Vocabulary.IsTerminalStateForClass(effectClass, input.TerminalState))
+                    {
+                        Rollback(connection);
+                        throw new ArgumentException(
+                            $"Terminal state '{input.TerminalState}' is not in the closed terminal set for effect class '{effectClass}' (P1-C103-P1-C105).",
+                            nameof(input));
+                    }
+
+                    var existing = ScalarString(connection,
+                        "SELECT EffectId FROM TerminalReceipts WHERE EffectId = @effect_id;",
+                        ("@effect_id", input.EffectId));
+                    if (existing is not null)
+                    {
+                        // Conflicting terminal: original stands, history is never rewritten,
+                        // conflict evidence persists per event (P1-C112).
+                        Rollback(connection);
+                        denialReceiptId = RecordDenialInNewTransaction(new DenialReceiptInput(
+                            input.EffectId, PermissionId: null,
+                            ReceiptPersistenceSchema.Vocabulary.TerminalConflictCode,
+                            WinnerEffectId: null,
+                            LinkedReceiptId: existing,
+                            DeniedAtUtc: input.TerminalAtUtc));
+                        return false;
+                    }
+
+                    var costKnown = input.SettledAmountMinor is not null;
+                    Execute(connection, @"
+INSERT INTO TerminalReceipts (
+    EffectId, TerminalState, SettledAmountMinor, Currency, CostPendingMarker,
+    EvidenceManifestHash, DenialReceiptId, StateOrigin, CreatedAtUtc)
+VALUES (
+    @effect_id, @terminal_state, @settled_amount_minor, @currency, @cost_pending_marker,
+    @evidence_manifest_hash, @denial_receipt_id, @state_origin, @created_at_utc);",
+                        ("@effect_id", input.EffectId),
+                        ("@terminal_state", input.TerminalState),
+                        ("@settled_amount_minor", (object?)input.SettledAmountMinor ?? DBNull.Value),
+                        ("@currency", (object?)input.Currency ?? DBNull.Value),
+                        ("@cost_pending_marker", costKnown ? DBNull.Value : (object)ReceiptPersistenceSchema.Vocabulary.PendingUnknownCostCode),
+                        ("@evidence_manifest_hash", input.EvidenceManifestHash),
+                        ("@denial_receipt_id", (object?)input.DenialReceiptId ?? DBNull.Value),
+                        ("@state_origin", ReceiptPersistenceSchema.Vocabulary.DurableStateOrigin),
+                        ("@created_at_utc", Format(input.TerminalAtUtc)));
+
+                    Commit(connection);
+                    return true;
+                }
+                catch
+                {
+                    TryRollback(connection);
+                    throw;
+                }
+            }
+            catch (SQLiteException ex) when (IsBusyOrLocked(ex) && attempt < MaxRetries)
+            {
+                Thread.Sleep(10 * (attempt + 1));
+            }
+        }
+    }

+    /// <summary>
+    /// Appends one settlement/adjustment/refund/human-resolution record (P1-C115/P1-C116):
+    /// it never rewrites the terminal or a prior settlement, and unknown cost may only be
+    /// resolved through these appends. Settlement against a missing terminal denies with
+    /// per-event FLEET_DENIED_TERMINAL_MISSING evidence (P1-C102); a duplicate settlement id
+    /// denies with FLEET_DENIED_REPLAY evidence. Both return false; repeats never throw.
+    /// </summary>
+    public bool TryAppendSettlement(SettlementInput input, out string? denialReceiptId)
+    {
+        ValidateSettlementInput(input);
+        denialReceiptId = null;
+
+        for (var attempt = 0; ; attempt++)
+        {
+            try
+            {
+                using var connection = OpenChecked();
+
+                using (var begin = connection.CreateCommand())
+                {
+                    begin.CommandText = "BEGIN IMMEDIATE;";
+                    begin.ExecuteNonQuery();
+                }
+
+                try
+                {
+                    var duplicate = ScalarString(connection,
+                        "SELECT SettlementId FROM Settlements WHERE SettlementId = @settlement_id;",
+                        ("@settlement_id", input.SettlementId));
+                    if (duplicate is not null)
+                    {
+                        Rollback(connection);
+                        denialReceiptId = RecordDenialInNewTransaction(new DenialReceiptInput(
+                            input.EffectId, PermissionId: null,
+                            ReceiptPersistenceSchema.Vocabulary.ReplayCode,
+                            WinnerEffectId: null,
+                            LinkedReceiptId: duplicate,
+                            DeniedAtUtc: input.SettledAtUtc));
+                        return false;
+                    }
+
+                    var terminal = ScalarString(connection,
+                        "SELECT EffectId FROM TerminalReceipts WHERE EffectId = @effect_id;",
+                        ("@effect_id", input.EffectId));
+                    if (terminal is null)
+                    {
+                        // Missing terminal: fail closed with durable evidence (P1-C102,
+                        // FLEET_DENIED_TERMINAL_MISSING).
+                        Rollback(connection);
+                        denialReceiptId = RecordDenialInNewTransaction(new DenialReceiptInput(
+                            input.EffectId, PermissionId: null,
+                            "FLEET_DENIED_TERMINAL_MISSING",
+                            WinnerEffectId: null,
+                            LinkedReceiptId: null,
+                            DeniedAtUtc: input.SettledAtUtc));
+                        return false;
+                    }
+
+                    var costKnown = input.SettledAmountMinor is not null;
+                    Execute(connection, @"
+INSERT INTO Settlements (
+    SettlementId, EffectId, ReservationId, PriorSettlementId, Kind,
+    SettledAmountMinor, Currency, CostPendingMarker, EvidenceManifestHash, StateOrigin, CreatedAtUtc)
+VALUES (
+    @settlement_id, @effect_id, @reservation_id, @prior_settlement_id, @kind,
+    @settled_amount_minor, @currency, @cost_pending_marker, @evidence_manifest_hash, @state_origin, @created_at_utc);",
+                        ("@settlement_id", input.SettlementId),
+                        ("@effect_id", input.EffectId),
+                        ("@reservation_id", (object?)input.ReservationId ?? DBNull.Value),
+                        ("@prior_settlement_id", (object?)input.PriorSettlementId ?? DBNull.Value),
+                        ("@kind", input.Kind),
+                        ("@settled_amount_minor", (object?)input.SettledAmountMinor ?? DBNull.Value),
+                        ("@currency", (object?)input.Currency ?? DBNull.Value),
+                        ("@cost_pending_marker", costKnown ? DBNull.Value : (object)ReceiptPersistenceSchema.Vocabulary.PendingUnknownCostCode),
+                        ("@evidence_manifest_hash", (object?)input.EvidenceManifestHash ?? DBNull.Value),
+                        ("@state_origin", ReceiptPersistenceSchema.Vocabulary.DurableStateOrigin),
+                        ("@created_at_utc", Format(input.SettledAtUtc)));
+
+                    Commit(connection);
+                    return true;
+                }
+                catch
+                {
+                    TryRollback(connection);
+                    throw;
+                }
+            }
+            catch (SQLiteException ex) when (IsBusyOrLocked(ex) && attempt < MaxRetries)
+            {
+                Thread.Sleep(10 * (attempt + 1));
+            }
+        }
+    }

+    /// <summary>
+    /// Applies the P1-C113 leak quarantine (the only permitted reservation state transition):
+    /// a post-terminal surviving reservation is quarantined; budget is not reused until
+    /// append-only reconciliation. Idempotent-safe: a missing or already-quarantined
+    /// reservation returns false without mutating anything (repeat-safe, never throws).
+    /// </summary>
+    public bool TryQuarantineReservation(string reservationId, DateTimeOffset quarantinedAtUtc)
+    {
+        ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(reservationId);
+
+        for (var attempt = 0; ; attempt++)
+        {
+            try
+            {
+                using var connection = OpenChecked();
+
+                using var update = connection.CreateCommand();
+                update.CommandText = @"
+UPDATE BudgetReservations
+SET Status = 'quarantined', QuarantinedAtUtc = @quarantined_at_utc
+WHERE ReservationId = @reservation_id AND Status = 'active';";
+                update.Parameters.AddWithValue("@quarantined_at_utc", Format(quarantinedAtUtc));
+                update.Parameters.AddWithValue("@reservation_id", reservationId);
+
+                return update.ExecuteNonQuery() == 1;
+            }
+            catch (SQLiteException ex) when (IsBusyOrLocked(ex) && attempt < MaxRetries)
+            {
+                Thread.Sleep(10 * (attempt + 1));
+            }
+        }
+    }

+    /// <summary>
+    /// Opens a store connection and fails closed on a torn v2 schema before any state is
+    /// read or written (see the class doc: consumption fails closed at the store, not only
+    /// at schema initialization).
+    /// </summary>
+    private SQLiteConnection OpenChecked()
+    {
+        var connection = ReceiptPersistenceSchema.OpenConnection(_connectionString);
+        try
+        {
+            ReceiptPersistenceSchema.ValidateV2OrThrow(connection);
